- None of the documents has a date or a named author.
- The write test lasted only two hours, and no write measurement was taken on the shard 3 canary.
- Nothing shows the other seven shards are similar to shard 3 in size or data, even though D5 gives one "per shard" figure.
- No plan exists for a failed concurrent build, which leaves an invalid index behind that has to be dropped.
